TYPE ST_Recipe :
STRUCT
    recipeID : INT;
    totalRatio : REAL;
    temperature : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    recipe : ARRAY[1..8] OF ST_Recipe;
    selSlot : INT;
    loadCmd : BOOL;
    running : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    valid : BOOL;
    loadedID : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    tmp_cmd_was_high : BOOL := FALSE;
    tmp_rising : BOOL;
    tmp_idx_valid : BOOL;
    tmp_recipe_ok : BOOL;
END_VAR
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT ... *)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)
tmp_rising := loadCmd AND NOT tmp_cmd_was_high;

IF NOT running THEN
   IF tmp_rising THEN
      IF selSlot >= 1 AND selSlot <= 8 THEN
         IF recipe[selSlot].recipeID <> 0
            AND recipe[selSlot].totalRatio >= 99.0
            AND recipe[selSlot].totalRatio <= 101.0
            AND recipe[selSlot].temperature >= 30.0
            AND recipe[selSlot].temperature <= 180.0 THEN
            valid := TRUE;
            loadedID := recipe[selSlot].recipeID;
         ELSE
            valid := FALSE;
            loadedID := 0;
         END_IF;
      ELSE
         valid := FALSE;
         loadedID := 0;
      END_IF;
   END_IF;
END_IF;

tmp_cmd_was_high := loadCmd;
